Class ExperienceTestbed

java.lang.Object
applicationMain.ExperienceTestbed
public final class ExperienceTestbed extends Object

Title: ExperienceTestbed

Description: Semi-automated positive/negative checks for the Contributor experience story. PASS requires the expected value or specific validation message; unexpected exceptions stop the run. A legacy schema and a separate JVM exercise additive migration and real file persistence, without touching normal user data.

    • main

      public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception
      Runs isolated tests; arguments are internal child-process persistence parameters.
      • EXP-01/02/03: existing lesson migration, empty history, complete saved values, and multiple attempts without overwriting the original lesson.
      • EXP-04 through 13: required fields, numeric formats, member effort, maximum lengths, exact boundaries, and rejected requests leaving history unchanged.
      • EXP-14 through 21: account/lesson access, distinct histories, literal quoted text, and an immutable read result. Each rejection checks its error message.
      • EXP-22/23: separate-process persistence and parent-delete cleanup. These tests fail on missing data, wrong values, a nonzero child exit, or orphan records.
      Parameters:
      args - empty for a normal test run
      Throws:
      Exception - if a test, storage operation, or cleanup fails
